We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 758105) to the molecule (target). We have the mapped_rxn from previous step. Need to apply template to target molecule to get precursors. We need target SMILES. Not given directly. The mapped_rxn shows product: [CH3:1][S:2](=[O:3])(=[O:4])[N:5]([CH2:6][CH2:7][Cl:8])[CH2:9][CH2:10][Cl:11]. So product SMILES without mapping: CH3S(=O)(=O)N(CH2CH2Cl)CH2CH2Cl? Actually N attached to CH2CH2Cl and also CH2CH2Cl? Wait N:5 attached to [CH2:6][CH2:7][Cl:8] as substituent, and also attached to [CH2:9][CH2:10][Cl:11] as second substituent? The product is a sulfonamide with two 2-chloroethyl groups (bis(2-chloroethyl) sulfonamide). So target SMILES: CS(=O)(=O)N(CCCl)CCCl with a methyl on S. So SMILES: CS(=O)(=O)N(CCCl)CCCl. Let's construct: "CS(=O)(=O)N(CCCl)CCCl". That seems correct.

Now apply template ID 758105 retrosynthetic. Use apply_template tool.
